name: Pare-Bench
intro: Pare-Bench 是 PARE 主动助手研究环境中的评测基准，包含 143 个跨通信、生产力、日程和生活应用的多样任务。PARE 将移动应用建模为有限状态机，并通过主动用户仿真构造情境，使 proactive assistant 必须观察用户行为、推断目标、判断干预时机并跨应用执行任务。
build_method: 有限状态机应用建模, 主动用户仿真, 情境任务构建
metric: Task success, goal inference, intervention timing
task_type: 主动助手任务, Agent任务, 多应用编排
eval_feature: 主动性, 用户仿真, 多应用编排, 干预时机
scale: 143个任务, 9个领域应用, 2个系统应用
task_type_en: Proactive assistant task, Agent task, Multi-app orchestration
build_method_en: Finite-state app modeling, active user simulation, scenario construction
eval_feature_en: Proactivity, user simulation, multi-app orchestration, intervention timing
intro_en: Pare-Bench is the benchmark built on the PARE proactive assistant research environment. It contains 143 diverse tasks across communication, productivity, scheduling, and lifestyle apps. PARE models mobile applications as finite state machines and uses active user simulation, forcing proactive assistants to observe user behavior, infer goals, decide when to intervene, and execute tasks across apps.
metric_en: Task success, goal inference, intervention timing
